news.title: The Tournament Reward Distribution
news.summary: We will start calculating the rankings of the 64th World Tournament after it ends. Please check out the information on reward distribution inside.

bodies.description:
Dear Players,

The final ranking calculation for the 64th
World Tournament will be performed from
Mon. 10/26 06:00 UTC to Wed. 10/28 05:59 UTC.

Every participant's Total Tournament Points and
ranking will be finalized within this time frame.
You will not be able to enter the Tournament
during this period.

In addition, if you finish a round of the Tournament
outside the event period, the items and Tournament
Points earned in the round will be lost. Please finish
all of your Tournament rounds within the time frame.

The final time to claim the Event Mission rewards
and ranking rewards is as follows:
Wed. 11/11 05:59 UTC

Please be aware that you will not be able to claim
the rewards after the time above.

The ranking rewards of the 64th World Tournament are
planned to be delivered to participants in a sequential
order from Wed. 10/28 06:00 UTC.

The ranking rewards will be sent to your Gift Box.
Please claim the rewards there.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

Stages 23 and 24 are available!

Become a master of
forming Category teams!


You can attempt a stage by forming a team with
the required number of characters! Players who
haven't taken on Challenge Events before should
definitely give this event a try!

= Event Details =

Attempt each stage with a team that includes
3 or 5 characters of the specified Category!

The characters who appear in the stages
will activate various skills, and they will
become more powerful as the battle progresses!

Form teams with various characters and attempt the event!

* For more information on the enemies and the stages,
please tap the "Stage Details" button located at the top
of the screen before you attempt the stage or the
"Battle Details" button located at the top of the battle screen.

* Including the Friend character, you must include 3 or
5 characters of the specified Category on your team.

= Rewards =

Complete the missions to get Category-exclusive Skill Orbs!
The Skill Orbs can be equipped by characters who belong to
the Categories specified in this event's stages! Strengthen
characters and aim to clear the stages!

In addition, 240 Dragon Stones can be obtained by completing
all the missions, so make sure to attempt them!

* Please navigate the following path for more details:
"Mission --> Event".

= Event Period =

Permanently available.

* Please note that the event content and dates are
subject to change without prior warning.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

news.title:
UR Premium Select Characters
Dokkan Festival!
news.summary: The event period is almost over! Don't forget to make an exchange at Baba's Shop!

bodies.description:
Use a "UR Premium Dragon Stone 7" to recruit
a UR character who has undergone all the available
Dokkan Awakenings and reached max level!

"UR Premium Dragon Stone 7" can be obtained by
purchasing Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 1 and
Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 2!

* The aforementioned Treasure Item can be obtained
by purchasing the specified Step-Up Dragon Stone
Sets at "Shop" during the event period.

* The Step-Up Dragon Stone Sets are available for
purchase until Tue. 10/20 14:59 UTC.

* Please go to the "Treasure" section of Baba's Shop
for more information on the list of available characters.

- List of Premium Select Characters

= Event Period =

- UR Premium Select Characters Dokkan Festival
Sat. 8/29 09:00 - Tue. 10/27 14:59 UTC

- Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 1 [With UR Premium Dragon Stone 7]
- Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 2 [With UR Premium Dragon Stone 7]
Sat. 8/29 09:00 - Tue. 10/20 14:59 UTC

= Notes =

* Please note that the Premium Select Characters
available for exchange are different depending on
the type of Treasure Item used.

* If a "UR Premium Dragon Stone 7" is not used during
the event period, it will be rendered obsolete after the
event ends. In addition, it will be deleted 180 days after
being claimed.

* "UR Premium Dragon Stone 7" and "Dragon Stone"
from "Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 1 [With UR Premium
Dragon Stone 7]" and "Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 2
[With UR Premium Dragon Stone 7]" are paid items.

* Each Step-Up Dragon Stone Set can be purchased
once during the event period.

* After you purchase Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 1 or
Step-Up Dragon Stone Set 2, "UR Premium Dragon
Stone 7" will be sent directly to your Gift Box.

* Please go to the "Treasure" section of Baba's Shop
to recruit a Premium Select Character.

* Please note that the event content and dates are
subject to change without prior warning.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

news.title: Regarding Account Suspension
news.summary: Please check out the information on account suspension as a result of misconducts.

bodies.description:
Dear Players,

Thank you for the continuous support for
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

Please be informed that the administration team of
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle has the right to suspend
the account of any user found violating the Terms of Service.

=== Example Violations ===

- Tampering with in-game data
- Tampering with the calculation of Tournament Points
- The use of external tools and/or illegal software
- Any use of other practices that violate laws or the
Terms of Use.

=== Handling of Accounts That Violate the Terms of Service ===

The administration team has the right to suspend the
accounts of users who violate the Terms of Service.

Once an account is suspended due to violation, the owner
will not be able to log in and play anymore. Please enjoy
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle while following the rules.

=== Notice Regarding Account Transfer ===

If an account is found in violation of the Terms of Service,
it will be suspended even if the owner at the time obtained
the account from an account transfer made by other players.
The suspension cannot be lifted. For this reason, please do
not receive or give accounts from or to other players.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!
